title: [3.4] Bolus Progress notification on Wear does not show total amount of insulin to be delivered
symptom: Due to Bolus Progress refactoring in 3.4, the string showing total amount to be delivered was removed, so on watch you don't see the total amount to be delivered.
cause: The Bolus Progress refactoring removed the string that included the total amount, and the string is now the same for all drivers but without the total amount.
fix: The issue reporter fixed it by reverting the change from Bolus Progress refactoring, but a maintainer suggests a better solution: add a dedicated BolusProgressData.wearStatus and build the additional string with total amount in EventOverviewBolusProgress. A pull request #4480 was proposed.
